task:
Make a narrow follow-up repair on draft PR #585, current platform head `001a0c55c2ca7320181d3136a8496a773728a7f8`. First merge/update from current integration branch `migration/svelte-cypress-hard-cut` exact head `2afae6477db57a22b9100ff893acaac39d9537b8` using normal ancestry and preserve all Cypress-only work. Work only on the existing platform branch, do not open another PR, do not merge PRs, and do not reintroduce Playwright. Read CLAUDE.md and the acceptance policy first.

Fix these verified defects only, plus directly necessary tests:

1. `collectionEnvelope()` in `apps/web/src/lib/persistence/storage.ts` currently casts the result of `canonicaliseIds(...)` directly to `VersionedCollection`. When a nested `id64` is invalid/unsafe, `canonicaliseIds` returns `INVALID_PERSISTED_VALUE`; the cast makes that non-null symbol look like a successful validator result to `jsonCodec`, allowing malformed persisted collections to hydrate. Capture the normalised value, require it to be a record with a record-valued `state`, a finite non-negative integer version not newer than the codec's accepted version, and no sentinel. Return null on any invalid nested identifier. Preserve unknown valid fields. Add regressions for unsafe numeric id64, malformed string id64, valid uint64 max, nested arrays/records, missing/wrong state, fractional/negative/NaN-like versions, and newer envelope preservation. Apply the same no-sentinel discipline to any other validator that currently trusts a cast from `canonicaliseIds`.

2. Root selected-system establishment can race persistence hydration. `AppShell.svelte` has a `$effect` that writes `overlayId ?? routeSelection`, while `onMount` hydrates stores. Ensure all application stores hydrate exactly once before any URL-derived selection is persisted or any persistence-dependent UI decision is made. Use an explicit browser-ready/hydrated state or a single ordered onMount bootstrap plus a guarded reactive effect. On cold load with an overlay/system route, the URL selection must win and then persist; on a normal route, the existing valid durable selection must remain; closing an overlay removes only the URL parameter and never clears the durable selected-system context. No storage write may occur during SSR. Add Svelte/Vitest and Cypress regressions for old stored selection + new URL overlay, cold `/system/{id}`, normal route hydration, overlay close, uint64 max, and exactly-once hydration.

3. Check that `providePersistenceContext()` returns the same application-store singleton used by `hydrateApplicationStores()` and that tests cannot accidentally leave the module hydration flag set across cases. Keep reset seams test-only and prevent production callers from resetting hydration. Do not expose session token values in diagnostics.

4. Keep the query singleton, structured generated-call `ApiError`, bounded admin-token policy, lossless JSON, route/hash compatibility and every existing platform contract unchanged except where directly required above. Do not port feature UI or delete React.

5. Run `pnpm check`, lint, format check, unit tests, build, focused Python platform contracts, storage/routing tests and Svelte Cypress platform coverage where feasible. Commit a coherent descendant through the trusted wrapper. No production, live DB, host, secret, DNS, OAuth activation, deployment, recovery or Babylon work.
